3617-4423-6886-8344.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
3617-4423-6886-8344.notablePrerequisites: Nog's second activated ability has been activated.
3617-4423-6886-8344.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Time Walk from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk during your draw step.
Repeat.

1770-2226-2908.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
1770-2226-2908.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Elesh Norn.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Dream Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When Dream Stalker enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

3554-3617-7164.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Solve the Equation by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting into your hand.
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Solve the Equation and Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Repeat.

Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Oketra's Monument triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

586-1739-3899-5258-5618.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3330-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3330-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2557-4094-4826-7824-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

301-6461-7859.description:
Activate Goblin Chirurgeon by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, Warden of the Grove triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin.
Resolve the Goblin Chirurgeon ability.
Repeat.

1458-2539-3400-4762-6306.notablePrerequisites: Devoted Druid has an Aura attached to it.
1458-2539-3400-4762-6306.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting Devoted Druid.
Ivy triggers. Choose not to copy Banishing Knack
Resolve Banishing Knack
Cast Strong Back by paying {2}{G}, targeting Devoted Druid.
Ivy triggers, copying Strong Back twice due to Twinning Staff. Choose to have one copy target Ivy and the other copy target Devoted Druid.
Resolve all three Strong Backs, attaching one to Ivy and two to Devoted Druid.
Activate Devoted Druid using the ability given to it by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning the nontoken Strong Back from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 two additional times, then repeat step 8 one additional time.
Repeat from step 4.
1458-2539-3400-4762-6306.notes: You can start the combo without Devoted Druid having an Aura attached to it if you provide an additional {2} to start. If you do this, during step 10, only repeat the steps as able until Devoted Druid has toughness equal to 1 and is untapped. Then move to step 11.

1563-3480-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1563-3480-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1563-3480-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1778-2232-4541-5705.manaNeeded: {2} at most if you control fewer than eight Treasures
1778-2232-4541-5705.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six Treasures.
1778-2232-4541-5705.description:
Activate at least six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least {6}.
Cast Marut by paying at least {6} gained from Treasures, plus an extra up to {2} if needed.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Cloudstone Curio and Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Memnite from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Marut. When Marut enters, it triggers, creating a Treasure for each mana from a Treasure spent to cast it.
Cast Memnite by paying its mana cost.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Cloudstone Curio and Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Marut from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
If needed, activate up to two Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C} for each one sacrificed.
Repeat.
1778-2232-4541-5705.notes: If you control seven or more Treasures, use at least seven Treasures to cast Marut. If you use eight Treasures, forego step 13.

2438-4907-6556-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1169-1374-3626-5499--24.description:

Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

628-2193-4779.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Chainbreaker.
When Chainbreaker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability
Repeat.

2921-3817-4200.description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Icewind Stalwart.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart ability, blinking Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Icewind Stalwart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

296-3532-3536-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
296-3532-3536-5078.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker, triggering its ability. Choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
The Thirteenth Doctor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2

104-2741-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-2741-4186.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1947-3327-4613-6258.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1947-3327-4613-6258.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Activate Dargo using Reckless Barbarian's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

957-1737-2707-6504.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Conjurer's Bauble.
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Activate the Conjurer's Bauble token by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Time Stretch onto the bottom of your library from your graveyard, and then causing you to draw Time Stretch from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat each other turn.

3179-4518-6406.manaNeeded: {W} if you don't control an untapped white creature
3179-4518-6406.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {W} or by tapping a white creature.
Oketra's Monument triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher spell.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

856-1808-4231-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Eloise's second ability triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1669-2653-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
You control at least eight lands.
1669-2653-5720-5721.description:
Activate Thaumatog's first ability by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland, giving +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Nissa triggers that many times, adding {G} for each land that entered the battlefield this way.
Repeat.
If you control nine or more lands, this combo will net infinite mana due to Nissa's trigger.

When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers 50 times, causing you to gain 100 life.
Repeat.

2757-3525-3590.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Warchanter Skald.
You control a basic Island.
2757-3525-3590.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Warchanter Skald, targeting a basic Island you control.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker creature token.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping the Island.
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Warchanter Skald.
Repeat.

1283-2440-2695.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Beasts.
1283-2440-2695.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Soul of Zendikar's first ability by paying {5}, creating a 3/3 Beast creature token.
The Beast enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

539-2266-3430.notablePrerequisites: Phyrexian Ironfoot does not have summoning sickness.
539-2266-3430.description:
Activate Phyrexian Ironfoot by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Ironfoot by paying {1}{S}, untapping it.
Repeat.

95-1022.description: Declare Lord Xander as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing an opponent to mill a number of cards equal to half their library, rounded down, times two due to Bruvac.
95-1022.notes: If the targeted opponent has an odd number of cards in their library, they will have one card remaining. If they have an even number, they will mill their entire library.

2034-2399-3693-4809.notablePrerequisites: At least one +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
2034-2399-3693-4809.description:
Sacrifice Walking Ballista to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}.
Colfenor triggers, returning Shifting Wall from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Shifting Wall for {1}.
Sacrifice Shifting Wall to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}.
Colfenor triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Walking Ballista for {2}.
Repeat.

937-2935-4591.description:
During your upkeep, activate Ethereal Champion by paying 1 life, preventing the next one damage that will be dealt to Ethereal Champion this turn.
Repeat step 1 until you have zero life.
Activate Magus of the Mirror by tapping and sacrificing it, exchanging your life total with an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
